newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia SIR20 rubber edges up in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia SIR20 rubber edges up in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged up in slow late trading on Friday following fresh Singapore and European enquiries, dealers said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for December/January shipments edged up 0.25-0.50 cents/lb to 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Jambi and Pontianak, to 56.00-56.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and to 55.75-56.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang.
"Fresh enquiries from Europe and Singapore have boosted market sentiment," one dealer in Jakarta said.
He said Singapore firms bought late on Thursday SIR20 at 56.00 cents/lb fob Medan for December/January deliveries.
One Padang dealer said he expected to ship around 1,300 tonnes of SIR20 mostly to the United States in November against an expected 1,800 tonnes in October due to to likely slow demand.
Dealers said RSS1 was last sold on Thursday at 125.50 cents/kg fob Semarang for December deliveries to Europe against the previous 123 cents/kg.
They said RSS1 prices were expected to be steady in the coming days due to likely rising demand.
High amoniac grade latex, with 60 percent dry rubber content, was last traded at 2,200 rupiah/kg for October delieveries against the previous 2,230 rupiah, latex dealers said.
